# Hatch's Bounty: the Bristlewood

*Hatch collects a bounty from the caravans for every beast cleared from the Bristlewood and passes it on to whoever does the work: defeat 60 bristle boars, barkbacks, ironhide hogs or reed-lurkers. Every round raises Urbanograd's regard for you, and Hatch will pay it again, any time.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Town | [Urbanograd](../towns/urbanograd_quests.md) |
| Category | Repeatable |
| Given by | [Hatch](../npcs/hatch.md) |
| Level | 30 |

## Objectives

- Defeat 60 Bristlewood monsters ([Bristle Boar](../monsters/bristle_boar.md), [Barkback](../monsters/barkback.md), [Ironhide Hog](../monsters/ironhide_hog.md), [Reed-Lurker](../monsters/reed_lurker.md))

## Rewards

- 27,200 EXP
- 3,600 mesos
- +40 standing with [Hatch](../npcs/hatch.md)
- +25 standing with Urbanograd
